cases.scope: A reshape/transpose/reshape chain moving a single unit axis.
cases.source_conditions: Reshapes only insert/delete/move unit dimensions; at most one unit dimension per shape; effective nonunit permutation is identity; endpoint shapes compatible.

cases.name: catalog_transpose_reshape_reshape_hoist_transpose
cases.scope: Two contiguous rank-two chunks of a rank-four tensor; symbolic extents.
cases.source_conditions: Outer reshape collapses contiguous chunks of transpose axes; no split or inserted unit dimension; chunks map to consecutive input axes.

cases.name: catalog_transpose_reshape_transpose_unit_dims
cases.scope: Rank-two input with one unit axis.
cases.source_conditions: p changes only positions of unit axes; nonunit relative order preserved.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_add_sparse_update
cases.scope: Rank-one update/slice with a scalar start.
cases.source_conditions: The updated base is a broadcast of scalar zero; shapes and index types are valid.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_add_scatter
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.
cases.source_conditions: Single scatter operand; scatter combiner is parameter addition.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. Scatter has one user.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_add_two_scatters_concat
cases.scope: Rank-one point-scatter operands with [count,1] indices and no batching.
cases.source_conditions: Equal scatter dimension numbers and index types; compatible update windows; at most one unequal non-vector/non-batching index dimension; batching extents match; unique_indices and indices_are_sorted are false.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. Both scatters have one user and concatenated updates are smaller than the result.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_add_two_scatters_nested
cases.scope: Single-operand unbatched scatter-add composition; source shape screening remains applicable.
cases.source_conditions: Both scatters use addition; equal index rank; source batching/shape screening passes; concatenation path is unavailable.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. One user per scatter; update-size screening as in the source.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_select_update
cases.scope: Rank-one base, predicate and update; one scalar start. Local HLO select requires the predicate and both branches to have the same shape.
cases.source_conditions: Same base X; source also matches the reversed branch order.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_reshape_update
cases.scope: Insert a leading unit dimension into a rank-one dynamic update.
cases.source_conditions: Reshape only inserts/deletes unit dimensions; same changes valid for update and base.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. Update has one user.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_concat_adjacent_slices
cases.scope: Adjacent rank-one unit-stride slices.
cases.source_conditions: Unit strides; same X; adjacent along d; same starts in other dimensions.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_concat_splat_to_pad
cases.scope: Rank-one low-edge scalar padding; high-edge form is symmetric. Edge padding is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: Binary concat; one side is scalar broadcast.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_iota_trivial
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.
cases.source_conditions: Extent of iota axis <= 1.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_pad_empty
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions. Edge padding is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: Input has zero elements.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_pad_interior_unit
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions. Edge padding is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: Clear positive interior padding only on input axes of extent one.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_reverse_trivial
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.
cases.source_conditions: All reversed dimensions have extent one.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_reverse_inserted_unit_dims
cases.scope: Insert one leading unit axis into rank-one input.
cases.source_conditions: Reshape only inserts unit dimensions.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_rotate_compose
cases.scope: Arbitrary-rank rotation over positive-extent selected axes; shifts combined modulo extent. Shift metadata is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: Shuffle type rotate; compose matching dimensions by adding shifts.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_slice_pad_only
cases.scope: Rank-one edge-padding-only slice, with arbitrary positive stride. Edge padding is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: On at least one axis all selected coordinates lie in edge padding.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_slice_pad_cancel
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions. Edge padding is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: Slice selects exactly original X positions: starts equal low padding; strides equal interior+1; compatible result shape.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_slice_inside_pad
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions. Edge padding is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: Entire slice inside unpadded region; no interior padding and unit strides.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_slice_reshape
cases.scope: Rank-two input flattened to rank one; slice selects complete rows.
cases.source_conditions: Only reshape output axis zero is sliced; flattened offset and size align to operand subdimension boundaries without crossing a rectangular subrange.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_slice_singleton_stride
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.
cases.source_conditions: A strided axis selects at most one element.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_dynamic_slice_identity
cases.scope: Rank-one full-shape dynamic slice.
cases.source_conditions: Scalar result or compatible operand/result shape.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_dynamic_slice_zero_index
cases.scope: Rank-two dynamic slice; first size covers its entire operand axis.
cases.source_conditions: On each changed axis slice size equals input extent, so clamping forces start zero.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_dynamic_slice_unit_reshape
cases.scope: Rank-one base with one inserted leading unit axis.
cases.source_conditions: Reshape only inserts/deletes unit axes.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. Skip async computations.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_dynamic_slice_transpose
cases.scope: Rank-two transpose with two scalar start operands.
cases.source_conditions: Valid transpose and dynamic slice.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. Skip async computations.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_dynamic_slice_iota
cases.scope: Rank-one, scalar-sized slice, i32 starts, optional scalar factor captured as Scale.
cases.source_conditions: Rank-one scalar-sized slice; base iota optionally multiplied by scalar literal; index type S32/U32 with compatible width.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_dynamic_slice_compose
cases.scope: Rank-one scalar i64 starts; explicit independent clamping before addition.
cases.source_conditions: Input extents fit index element types; source widens/converts indices as needed; index addition cannot overflow.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_update_zero_index
cases.scope: Rank-one, full-shape update; start becomes zero.
cases.source_conditions: On each changed axis update extent equals base extent.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_update_compose
cases.scope: Rank-one scalar i64 starts; explicit independently clamped composition.
cases.source_conditions: Inner base is a dynamic slice of the same X at the same outer starts; input extents fit index types; checked combination of indices.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_gather_empty
cases.scope: Empty input; gather result shape is adapter metadata.
cases.source_conditions: Operand has zero elements; source constructs a zero-like result of gather shape.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_gather_pad
cases.scope: Rank-two gather over rows; edge padding only on the passthrough column axis. Edge padding is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: Padding only on operand passthrough axes, or explicit batch axes padded identically in indices; indices pad no other axes.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_gather_reshape_pad
cases.scope: Rank-two input, inserted leading unit axis, padded passthrough column axis. Edge padding is nonnegative.
cases.source_conditions: Padded dimensions are unmodified by reshape and passthrough through gather.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_scatter_empty_update
cases.scope: Single-operand/result scatter; arbitrary combiner forwarded by source descriptor.
cases.source_conditions: All update tensors have zero elements; compatible replacement shapes.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_scatter_scalar_map
cases.scope: Single operand/result, empty scalar index vector, whole-tensor combining region.
cases.source_conditions: Single scatter operand; indices have zero elements; input/update/result shapes equal.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_transpose_scatter
cases.scope: Rank-two operand, rank-three updates with leading scatter axis, no batching.
cases.source_conditions: Single-operand simplified scatter; no operand/index batching dimensions.
cases.source_policy: Option enabled; one scatter user; written run length must not shrink.

cases.name: catalog_dot_empty
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.
cases.source_conditions: Result or either operand has zero elements.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. Sparse dots with extra operands are skipped.

cases.name: catalog_dot_drop_unit_dims
cases.scope: Remove a leading free unit axis from a rank-three left operand.
cases.source_conditions: At least one operand has unit axes.

cases.name: catalog_dot_transpose_both_operands
cases.scope: Rank-two matrix transposes, no batches.
cases.source_conditions: Equal operand permutations; equal ranks; canonical leading batch axes; one free and one contracting axis per side; p only permutes batch axes and optionally swaps final matrix axes.

cases.name: catalog_dot_constant_dynamic_slice
cases.scope: Rank-two dot with one selected left free-axis element. Captured C/D may be constants; the identity also holds for nonconstants.
cases.source_conditions: Rank-two operands; one contraction axis each; C,D literals; slice preserves full contracting axis and selects one element on the other axis.

cases.name: catalog_dot_move_contracting_permutation
cases.scope: Swap two contraction subdimensions before flattening; rank-three left operand.
cases.source_conditions: C constant; one contraction axis; reshape collapses a consecutive block into that axis; p only permutes the block.

cases.name: catalog_dot_move_zero_pad
cases.scope: Rank-two dot; nonnegative padding only on its left contraction axis.
cases.source_conditions: Padding value zero; only nonnegative contracting-axis padding is moved; other padding remains.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. use_associative_reordering; FLOP threshold.

cases.name: catalog_dot_move_broadcast
cases.scope: One broadcast-created contraction axis; replacement dot is an outer product.
cases.source_conditions: Moved broadcast-created axes are contracting; remaining broadcast axes stay on the producer side.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. use_associative_reordering; FLOP threshold.

cases.name: catalog_dot_slice_output
cases.scope: Rank-two dot with arbitrary output starts, sizes and positive strides.
cases.source_conditions: Slice affects output/free/batch axes, not hidden contracting axes; batch selections transported to both operands; resulting operands still each have free axes.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. raise_slice_and_reduce_through_dot.

cases.name: catalog_dot_reduce_output_free
cases.scope: Reduce the left free axis of a rank-two dot; implicit sum initializer zero.
cases.source_conditions: Dot has no batch axes; reducer is addition with zero initial value.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. raise_slice_and_reduce_through_dot; FLOP threshold.

cases.name: catalog_dot_scalar_multipliers
cases.scope: Scalar factor pulled from a rank-two f32 dot; source constant/profitability screening is outside the algebraic identity.
cases.source_conditions: Constant scalar factors along multiply-commuting operations; BF16 or F32; shared-user paths screened before mutation.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_empty
cases.scope: Single-output reduction with arbitrary initial value and empty input.
cases.source_conditions: Input or result has zero elements; tuple reductions handled componentwise.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_unit_axes
cases.scope: Zero-initialized sum specialization of the generic-combiner schema.
cases.source_conditions: Input/output element counts equal; source assumes valid identity initial value for f.
cases.source_policy: If layout-sensitive, reshape must be bitcast-compatible.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_reshape_reduced
cases.scope: Sum over a merged pair of reduced axes; rank-three input.
cases.source_conditions: Every surviving axis is unmodified by reshape.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. enable_reduce_of_reshape.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_reshape_free
cases.scope: Rank-three input; sum over first axis while reshape merges free axes.
cases.source_conditions: Every reduced axis is unmodified by reshape; only free axes split/merge.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. enable_reduce_of_reshape; one user or unconditional simplify flag.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_splat_min
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.
cases.source_conditions: Nonempty input; scalar X; all broadcast axes reduced; exact source combiner.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_splat_max
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.
cases.source_conditions: Nonempty input; scalar X; all broadcast axes reduced; exact source combiner.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_splat_and
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions. Local HLO logical operations use Boolean tensors; integer bitwise variants are not verified.
cases.source_conditions: Nonempty input; scalar X; all broadcast axes reduced; exact source combiner.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_splat_or
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions. Local HLO logical operations use Boolean tensors; integer bitwise variants are not verified.
cases.source_conditions: Nonempty input; scalar X; all broadcast axes reduced; exact source combiner.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_broadcast_original_axes
cases.scope: Sum specialization; rank-one base and one broadcast-created axis.
cases.source_conditions: Every reduced output axis belongs to d (no replication axis is reduced).

cases.name: catalog_reduction_broadcast_replication_axes
cases.scope: Reduce all appended replication axes; zero-initialized sum, symbolic replication count.
cases.source_conditions: All reduced axes are broadcast-created; d sorted; source additive combiner.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_window_empty
cases.scope: Single-output reduction window with nonnegative edge padding and empty input.
cases.source_conditions: Input or output has zero elements; variadic results treated componentwise.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_window_scalar
cases.scope: Rank-zero zero-initialized sum window.
cases.source_conditions: Rank-zero input; source identity-initializer convention; supported tuple-root form for variadic case.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_window_splat_cumsum
cases.scope: Rank-one cumulative sum of a scalar f32 broadcast; scalar constant can be a capture.
cases.source_conditions: Zero init and additive reducer; scalar literal through source-recognized reshape/convert/slice/copy/value-preserving-bitcast chains; exactly one nontrivial full-extent cumulative window; stride=1, low pad=size-1, high pad=0, no dilation/reversal; other axes trivial.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_window_singleton_add
cases.scope: Unit windows and nonnegative edge padding; scalar initializer preserved.
cases.source_conditions: Every window size/stride/base-dilation/window-dilation is one; no reversal; exact source combiner.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_window_singleton_min
cases.scope: Unit windows and nonnegative edge padding; scalar initializer preserved.
cases.source_conditions: Every window size/stride/base-dilation/window-dilation is one; no reversal; exact source combiner.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_window_singleton_max
cases.scope: Unit windows and nonnegative edge padding; scalar initializer preserved.
cases.source_conditions: Every window size/stride/base-dilation/window-dilation is one; no reversal; exact source combiner.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_window_to_reduce
cases.scope: Arbitrary-rank f32 zero-initialized sum windows, each axis unit or full.
cases.source_conditions: No stride/dilation/padding; each window axis is size one or covers the whole input axis and yields output extent one.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_slice_window_to_reduce
cases.scope: Last element of a rank-one full cumulative window; f32 sum.
cases.source_conditions: Padded full-window pattern; no stride or dilation; each axis either unchanged with window size one, or selected last singleton of full-window output.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_window_pad
cases.scope: Single-result window; nonnegative padding equals the initializer; reducer region forwarded.
cases.source_conditions: No negative pad; cannot combine interior padding with existing base dilation; padding value and init must agree under applicable literal/type checks; optional convert is preserved.
cases.source_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. Source scan-padding profitability screening and reduce-window-rewriter option.

cases.name: catalog_broadcast_window_padded_unit_broadcast
cases.scope: Rank-one f32 unit input, symmetric padding, every window includes the sole unpadded value.
cases.source_conditions: Source window-pad prerequisites; symmetric edge padding only on unit axes; no window stride; each window contains exactly one unpadded value; nonunit axes have window size one.

cases.name: catalog_convolution_empty
cases.scope: General convolution; result shape is ordinary source/adapter metadata.
cases.source_conditions: Input or filter has zero elements.

cases.name: catalog_convolution_fold_input_pad
cases.scope: One canonical spatial axis; no existing input dilation or convolution edge padding.
cases.source_conditions: Zero padding; batch/feature axes unpadded; no negative edges; interior padding does not conflict with convolution base dilation or other window padding.

cases.name: catalog_convolution_fold_filter_pad
cases.scope: One canonical spatial axis; filter interior padding becomes kernel dilation.
cases.source_conditions: Zero filter padding; no feature-axis padding/dilation; spatial edge padding zero; no simultaneous existing filter dilation.

cases.name: catalog_convolution_pointwise_dot
cases.scope: One-spatial-axis pointwise convolution in canonical layouts, no grouping or padding.
cases.source_conditions: All kernel spatial extents one; unit strides; no edge padding/base dilation; feature_group_count=batch_group_count=1; layouts permit value-preserving bitcasts.
cases.source_policy: enable_conv_simplification; layout-sensitive; input/output feature axis most minor; filter Cin more major than Cout.

cases.name: catalog_convolution_depthwise_product
cases.scope: Depthwise rank-three convolution whose kernel spans the full spatial extent.
cases.source_conditions: No sparse RHS; each spatial kernel extent one or output extent one; unit strides, no padding/dilation; kernel input feature extent one; input/output features equal feature_group_count.

cases.name: catalog_convolution_swap_operands
cases.scope: One spatial axis, unit strides/dilations, nonnegative transformed padding; kernel reversal, role swap and precision swap are explicit.
cases.source_conditions: Ungrouped; no sparsity/block scaling. Each spatial axis is either a source-recognized group/contraction axis or uses the transformed reversed window.
cases.source_policy: enable_conv_operand_swap; layout-insensitive; smaller transformed kernel; backend lowerability callback.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_pad_negative
cases.scope: Rank-one low crop -1 and high padding +2; signed pad metadata retained and crop bounds use nonnegative shape arithmetic.
cases.source_conditions: Negative edge padding present; legal crop sizes.

cases.name: native_power_two_splat
cases.scope: Arbitrary-rank numeric tensor and same-shape/type exponent splat represented by fill; where checks the value attribute equals 2. Does not inspect opaque dense literals.
cases.source_conditions: Exponent all two.

cases.name: native_abs_unsigned
cases.scope: Arbitrary-rank unsigned integer tensor; is_unsigned_integer establishes nonnegativity. Signed/floating range analysis is not implemented.
cases.source_conditions: IsNonNegative(X) succeeds under the source type/range analysis.

designated_targets.description: One explicit concrete rule for each of the original 192 expressible assessments; variant/rank restrictions remain in the per-case scope. This is not a claim of all conditional variants.
